'''''Star Wars: War of the Bounty Hunters''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] crossover event and miniseries from [[Marvel Comics]]. The comics were announced on [[February 16]], [[2021]] and began publication with the release of [[War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha'' 1]] on [[May 5]], 2021. Issues of the ongoing series ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunters]]'', [[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2020)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'']], [[Star Wars: Doctor Aphra (2020)|''Star Wars: Doctor Aphra'']], and [[Star Wars (2020)|''Star Wars'']] are included in the crossover event that also began in the month of [[May]]. The five issue miniseries by [[Charles Soule]] and [[Luke Ross]] began publication in [[June]] 2021 and concluded in [[November]].

''War of the Bounty Hunters'' re-introduces the character of [[Qi'ra]] and the [[Crimson Dawn]] criminal faction, the stories of which continued after ''War of the Bounty Hunters'' through the subsequent series ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Reign]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Hidden Empire]]''.<ref name="WOTBH 5">[[War of the Bounty Hunters 5|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 5]]</ref>
